description:
Meta Llama/Llama 4 Maverick 17B 128E Instruct language model

Meta Llama/Llama 4 Maverick 17B 128E Instruct is served by Hugging Face over an OpenAI-compatible API with a 1048576-token context window. Requests are proxied through the UnitySVC gateway; you bring your own Hugging Face API key, so token usage is billed by Hugging Face directly and the service is free through UnitySVC.

Reach it through the UnitySVC gateway with your own Hugging Face API key (the byok channel). The endpoint accepts both OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages requests — the gateway auto-detects the dialect, translates to the upstream, and returns the response in the format you sent. See the code examples for both styles.
